snippet.title: VILE: EXHUMED | VILEISBANNED.COM
snippet.description:
DO NOT PLAY • DANGER • BANNED • REMOVED FROM ALL STOREFRONTS • DO NOT WATCH

VILE: Exhumed is a deeply personal work by Cara Cadaver. An updated and expanded version of the cult itch.io release, VILE: Exhumed tasks you with unraveling a story about the horrors of parasociality, entitlement, and misogyny in the digital age by digging through hidden files on an obsolete computer.

This is raw horror, without metaphor or embellishment. With every discovery, you will be piecing together the winding, intriguing, and deeply upsetting story of one man’s single-minded obsession. 

As you may already know, VILE: Exhumed was wrongly banned from Steam for “sexual content with depictions of real people”, despite there being nothing of the sort included in the game. The game covers topics of assault, abuse, and entitlement, and uses a combination of FMV and practical effects predominantly featuring the developer to create images that are as horrifying as the themes the game deals with. Yes, the game includes intense visuals, but there is no uncensored nudity, no depictions of sex acts, and no pornography present in the game at all. 

In the interest of sharing Cara’s vision with the largest audience possible, even after being banned from Steam, VILE: Exhumed will be made available for free. However, if you feel so inclined, the game’s official website has info on how you can support the game, as well as Red Door Shelter, a charity she specifically selected. Red Door Shelter has, since 1982, provided emergency shelter and support for women and children affected by domestic abuse, families experiencing a housing crisis, and refugee claimants with nowhere else to turn. 50% of the profits from the game will go towards supporting this charity.

VILE: Exhumed is available now. 
https://vileisbanned.com
Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/PX25QrbGrw
Follow the Dev: https://x.com/dirtlord77
